title: Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria (draft v1, awaiting owner review)
description: Criteria-based checklist drafted from the supplied acute-dystonia criteria. The exact form name is Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria. There is no numeric scale and no total score in the source; none is invented here. Urgent airway assessment is independent of checklist completion.

steps: Establish the medication timeline, including antipsychotics, dopamine-blocking antiemetics, and changes to preventive anticholinergic medication.

Assess the distribution and persistence of abnormal postures (neck twisting, jaw spasm, tongue protrusion, sustained eye deviation, abnormal limb/trunk postures; throat involvement impairing speech, swallowing, or breathing).

Exclude catatonia, primary neurological or medical causes, and tardive movement disorders; investigate symptoms preceding exposure, unexplained focal findings, or progression unrelated to medication changes.
Screen for stridor or breathing difficulty at once; do not delay airway evaluation to complete this checklist.
administration.note: Typical onset is usually within days of initiation, rapid dose escalation, or reduction of medication preventing extrapyramidal symptoms. A rapid response to acute treatment supports the impression but does not replace differential diagnosis.

items.prompt: Sustained involuntary contractions with abnormal postures (neck twisting, jaw spasm, tongue protrusion, sustained eye deviation/oculogyric crisis, abnormal limb or trunk postures).
Plausible medication timeline (initiation, rapid escalation, or reduction of EPS-preventive medication, including antipsychotics and dopamine-blocking antiemetics).
Distribution and persistence of abnormal postures assessed and documented.

Catatonia, primary neurological/medical cause, and tardive movement disorder excluded as the explanation (with further investigation when symptoms precede exposure, focal findings are unexplained, or progression is unrelated to medication changes).
Urgent airway concern: stridor or breathing difficulty suggesting laryngeal dystonia.

completeness.rule: All 5 criteria items required when acute dystonia status is present. Absent and not_assessed require no questionnaire completion. Missing required items suppress calculated results to null (never zero) unless a reviewed source explicitly defines a missing-data rule; no such rule is defined here. Urgent handling never waits for completeness.

scoring.no_total_score: No total score exists in the source and none is invented. Results are the per-criterion record plus the urgent flag; there is no summed severity.
scoring.results: Complete present-case results preserve item responses, definition version, completeness, and nullable results (complete with all criteria recorded vs partial with missing list).

urgent.rule: Stridor or breathing difficulty can indicate laryngeal dystonia and requires emergency assessment. Do not delay airway evaluation to complete this checklist. The urgent flag (addx_urgent_airway yes) displays and routes independently of questionnaire completion, inference, or LLM latency, and a source-approved urgent message shows without waiting for inference.

source.note: Checklist drafted from the 17-line supplied acute-dystonia criteria; item wording tracks the source sections. Naming Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria does not establish a validated scored scale.

assumptions: Five checklist items cover the source sections without adding a numeric scale.
Urgent airway screening is item 5 and is also surfaced independently.
source_gaps: Item/completeness/severity/network mappings require owner review; no total score is proposed.

independent_examples.name: all_no_absent_pattern
independent_examples.expected: complete; no total; urgent false; supports absent-pattern review.

independent_examples.name: present_pattern_with_urgent
independent_examples.expected: complete; no total; urgent true with emergency assessment message independent of completion.

independent_examples.name: one_missing_suppresses
independent_examples.expected: partial; missing [addx_urgent_airway]; results null (never zero); urgent unknown until answered, but any yes airway concern already routes urgently.

independent_examples.name: urgent_without_completion
independent_examples.expected: partial overall, but urgent true routes immediately without waiting for the remaining criteria or any inference.

severity_mapping.reviewed_severity: Independent clinician-reviewed severity (mild|moderate|severe) recorded alongside the checklist when status is present; it is NOT a summed score. Concrete wording requires owner review.
severity_mapping.no_total_score: No total score is defined or summed.

network_mappings.F4_acute_dystonia: Effect presence plus reviewed severity plus onset/context fields plus explicit urgent concerns. Source review flags stay distinct from probabilistic output semantics.

mapping_gaps: Presence/onset/context fields, required-context-missing cases, and result-mapping examples require owner review before package use (S36).
Completion is required only when acute dystonia is present; absent/not_assessed have no completion requirement.
